feeds.title: My Montana Kitchen
feeds.description: Welcome to My Montana Kitchen! My name is Sarah, this is where I share easy, family friendly, healthy recipes. Many of my recipes are low carb, some are healthy carbs, and all are sugar free and Trim Healthy Mama Friendly!

feeds.title: Get Inspired Everyday » Food
feeds.description: Get Inspired with over 600+ recipes ranging from Clean Eating to paleo and Whole30 compliant recipes. Also gluten free and dairy free. Kari's goal is to keep recipes simple and filled with veggies to help you eat healthier!

feeds.title: Gluten-Free Prairie Blog
feeds.description: Take a look at our delicious gluten-free recipes. You'll find a little something for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and even dessert. We work hard to bring you the best products made with our certified gluten-free oats.

feeds.title: Glacier Country » Food
feeds.description: This section of the blog features articles on Food. Western Montana greets visitors from around the globe to piece of paradise, dedicated to promoting Western Montana as a travel and tourism destination.

feeds.title: RIPE Blog
feeds.description: RIPE Food & Wine is a blog based in Bozeman that shares home cooking recipes and tips, focusing on seasonal ingredients, simple techniques, and joyful eating.

feeds.title: Big Sky, Little Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi! I am Kristine. I cook recipes & create art in my Little Montana Home. I'm a photographer based out of the big sky state of Montana where I recently bought my first house.

feeds.title: Eat It & Say Yum
feeds.description: A collection of recipes, photos, ideas, and snippets from my life. Hi there! I'm Leia. The purpose of this blog is for me to share recipes, ideas, crafts, photos, a bit of cake decorating, and snippets from my life. Use my recipes to warm the hearts and bellies of those you love. Take time to cook together and grow those relationships.

feeds.title: Montana Outlaw BBQ Blog
feeds.description: Featuring updates on BBQ competitions, BBQ Hero, recipes, and deals on swag and Montana Outlaw BBQ Rubs. We are the Hamilton family. We are a competitive BBQ team, makers of BBQ rubs, and the guys behind BBQ Hero.

feeds.title: Northern Yum Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kelsey, the author & owner of Northern Yum. Making and sharing delicious food has always been a big part of my life. So sharing yummy recipes with you here at Northern Yum is a natural extension of that. I enjoy entertaining & hosting special events. And let's be honest the best part of both of those is the FOOD.

feeds.title: Felton Angus Beef Blog
feeds.description: Jim & Susie share their stories of everyday life, recipes for grilling and cooking steaks, burgers, roasts, and everything in between, and the hard work it takes to raise beef on this blog. Jim & Susie Felton at Felton Angus Beef owns a farming business that focuses on regenerative agriculture strengthening the health and vitality of farm soil, and utilizing clean water practices.

feeds.title: Montana's Mountain Maven Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Tina, I love sharing recipes with others. In my free time, I love to entertain, cook, bake, design, and organize my home. I hope you enjoy it, feeling the same inspiration for breaking bread and building relationships across the table with those you love.

feeds.title: Fantabulosity
feeds.description: Get easy dinner recipes, side dishes, appetizers, and desserts for weekly meal planning ideas or hosting a party! Jessica loves helping busy gals simplify & organize their lives to bring more joy and time for what matters.

feeds.title: Montana Mex
feeds.description: Organic, Gluten-free and vegan recipes by Montana Mex. We make products that help you find your best self in the kitchen, because we believe that sharing a meal has the power to bring people together.

feeds.title: Southwest Montana » Food
feeds.description: This section features articles on Food. Southwest Montana is blessed with some of Montana's finest trout fishing, beautiful scenery, and a mother-lode of history. Their mission is to promote economic development through tourism and film production for Southwest Montana Tourism Region.
